title: 第1章 时间暂停了
content_zh:
“来不及了！来不及了……让一让……让一让……”

建安市早市的小路上，苏林一路狂奔，在拥挤的人群当中穿梭着，时间已经是七点五十了，还有十分钟就要上课了。

“早知道菜市场这么多大妈，我就不抄近路了……”

拥挤的人群当中，充斥着各种买菜讨价还价地嘈杂声，此时的苏林心里面却是郁闷非凡，一边喊着借过，一边极力地往菜市场外面挤。

“完蛋了！昨天班主任林老师就已经警告过我了，如果这个星期再迟到就要叫家长了。可是今天是怎么搞的，我居然又睡过头了，不行……不行……今天貌似还是林老师在校门口值曰，这要是被她在校门口逮到我迟到，那……”

这周已经迟到两次了，苏林其实也不想的，谁让这五月的天气这么适宜打瞌睡，尤其是苏林这样没心没肺的更是睡得和猪一样了。

“不管了，还有十分钟，只要过了这个菜市场，再拐个弯，通过一个小道，就能够看到建安一中的大门了。跑快一点，应该可以赶在打铃之前。只要在铃声响了以后进入学校，想必林老师也不能说我什么……”

看了看手上十几块钱的廉价电子表，苏林在心里面快速盘算着。

终于，经过漫长的三分钟，苏林总算是在大妈当中杀出了一条血路。

“还有六七分钟，跑快点，肯定来得及！”

又看了看表，苏林舒了一口气，正准备一路狂奔到学校，却发现在这一头的菜市场门口，围着一堆人，叽叽喳喳地不知道在看什么热闹。

“这么多人围着？发生什么事儿了？难道是车祸？不对呀……这菜市场门口不让机动车行驶的……”

出于好奇，也是中国人普遍的看热闹心理，反正看一眼也耽搁不了多少时间，苏林也挤进看热闹的人群，探出脑袋来，往里面看去。

只见在众人围观之下，地面上居然躺着一个白发老奶奶，捂着胸口，痛苦地哼着，似乎是犯病了。而这些围观的人们在叽叽喳喳地讨论着要将老奶奶送到医院去，但是说的人多，真正要出手救助老奶奶的人却没有一个。

“哎呀……老人家犯病了，赶紧地送她到医院去……你们这些年轻力壮地小伙子怎么都不动呢？”

“我也想呀！可是万一到了医院，被讹上了怎么办？”

“快想想办法啊……老人家要不行了……”

“已经有人打了，救护车在路上，不过就算来了，怕是这个菜市场小路也开不进来……”

听到这些人的言语，苏林心里面也明白了，他们这些人都是怕送老奶奶到医院以后，反而被讹诈上了，这样的事件近来经常在电视上被报道，所以现在的人，都不敢轻易当好人了。

看着地上痛苦挣扎地老奶奶，苏林的心揪地一痛，他想起了自己年迈的奶奶，当即把心一横，也不想太多了，立马挣脱人群，冲上前去，一把将老奶奶抱了起来，就朝着菜市场出口方向的大路跑去，只要出了菜市场，就可以打车到市立医院去。

“这个小伙子难道不怕被讹诈么？”

苏林已经顾不得旁人的言语了，他现在心里面唯一的念头就是，他要救这个老奶奶，不管这个社会如何，不论是否事后会被讹诈。都不能够因为这些而让自己的良心被蒙昧下去。

“老奶奶，您挺住，我马上就送你去医院。”

已经耽搁了这么长的时间，苏林知道现在每一分每一秒对于老奶奶来说都是至关重要的了，他的双腿也已经飞奔起来了，心里面唯一的念头就是想着要尽快将老奶奶送到医院去。

“快点……快点……再快一点……”

苏林身高一米七出头，偏瘦，现在抱着老奶奶跑了这么远，也已经有些气喘吁吁了，可是他却依旧坚持着，苏林已经听到了救护车来的声音，只要过了这个弯儿就能够看到马路了。

被病痛折磨的老奶奶艰难地睁开眼睛，看着汗流浃背的苏林，吃力地感激道。

“老奶奶，您不要说话了，挺住，救护车到了，就在前面的路口，您马上就可以到医院了。”

拼尽最后的力气，苏林终于从小巷子里跑了出来，救护车已经停在了巷弄口，医护人员正搭建着担架准备进去救人。

“快……医生……救……老奶奶……”

小心翼翼地将老奶奶放在救护车上，苏林喘气已经说不出完整的话来了。

“小伙子，还好你送的及时，你放心吧！下面就交给我们了……”

跟着救护车来的医生简单地检查了一下老奶奶，也没有和苏林多说，立马就进入救护车当中一边往医院开，一边在路上抢救着。

看着救护车急速远去，苏林才松了一口气。一看手上的手表，却是立马想了起来，自己这还要赶着去上学，现在都已经七点五十七分了，还有三分钟就打铃了。

焦急地苏林嚷了一声，但是他却不知道，在这个时候，虚无的冥冥之中，一尊掌管着时间的神祗透过无限的时空恰好看到了苏林救人的这一幕。听到了苏林的这一声嘟囔，这一尊时间之神，挥舞着他的时间权杖，顿时，一道青色的气流跨越无数地时空吱溜一下钻入了苏林地身体当中。

“既然你没有时间了，那么本神就给你时间。”

随着那一道青色的气流钻入苏林的身体，苏林浑身一抖，差点一个踉跄摔倒在地。

“怎么回事？怎么突然感觉这么冷……”

停了一下，那种冰冷的感觉又消失了，苏林便再度朝着学校狂奔，虽然刚刚救老奶奶耽误了一点时间，可是好在方向是一致的，从这里再跑到建安一中也就一千多米了。

时间还有一分钟，再快一点应该来得及。

苏林已经远远地看到了在校门口巡视的班主任老师林清雪了，林清雪似乎也远远地看见背着书包狂奔的苏林了，可是偏偏在这个时候，上课铃叮铃铃响了起来。

上课铃陡然响了起来，对于苏林来说却仿佛像是丧钟一样。

“就差一点，就差一点点……如果这个时候时间能够暂停一下就好了，我就能够跑进校园里了……”

虽然因为救老奶奶导致迟到了，但是苏林并没有一点点后悔，只是他现在希望时间可以多那么一点点，或者暂停那么一下，这样自己就可以避免被林清雪抓住迟到了。

谁知道，苏林就这么一想，结果整个世界就突然暂停住了。不可思议，苏林看着眼前的一切，本来看见自己要前来说道的林老师，学校两旁被微风吹拂的柳树。

不！苏林发现，所有的一切都静止了，可是自己却还能够行动。刚刚苏林是保持着快速跑步的状态，而现在，很奇怪的感觉，周围的一切都静止了，但是苏林还在不停地往校园里跑。

跑到林老师跟前，看着林老师那黑色的小西装，白色略带透明的白衬衫，黑色的小皮裙包着黑丝袜地细腿，一动不动，苏林奇怪了，自己都跑到老师的跟前了，她却熟视无睹，甚至，连林清雪那随风飘动的长发也静止定格在了空中。

“怎么回事？怎么……怎么一切都不动了？”

苏林的心里面惊骇万分，不过他还是一口气先跑到了学校里面，花了几十秒的时间。但是，当苏林看了一下自己手上的电子表以后，却发现自己手上的电子表一动不动，就像是坏了一样，时间定格在八点一分，指针一动也不动。

再环顾一下四周，苏林确信了，时间真的暂停了，周围的任何事物，除了自己，所有的一切都静止了。

静！静得可怕，没有一丝的声音，死静死静的。

太可怕了，这种感觉，一片死寂，没有一丝的生气。

苏林真的怕了，如果让他一直在这样静止地时空生活下去，简直是不可想象。

“走啊！你动一下啊！你这破表，你走啊……”

在无边的恐惧包围下，苏林对着自己手表怒吼，这心念一动，周围的一切，又突然恢复了过来。

风继续吹，柳叶被拂动，校园里的早读声又响了起来，而苏林听到了校门口林清雪老师的一声惊疑。

“咦？奇怪了，我刚刚明明看到苏林那臭小子在校门外赶过来的，昨天我刚刚交代他的，今天居然又迟到。只是奇怪了，怎么人又不见了呢？难道是我出现幻觉了？”

听到林清雪的惊疑，就站在林清雪背后校门内的苏林知道时间又恢复了过来，哪里还敢继续在校门内呆着，趁着没有被林清雪发现，赶紧蹑手蹑脚地往高三（2）班的教室跑去。

但是，苏林这才打算溜，却不料林清雪一转身就发现了他，对着他大叫一声：“苏林，你给我站住！”
content_en:
"It's too late! It's too late... Give way... Give way..."

On the small road of the morning market in Jian'an City, Su Lin ran all the way, weaving in and out of the crowded crowd. The time was already 7:50, and class was about to start in ten minutes.

"If I had known there were so many aunties in the vegetable market, I wouldn't have taken shortcuts..."

The crowded crowd was filled with the noise of people bargaining for food. At this time, Su Lin felt extremely depressed. He shouted to borrow it while trying his best to squeeze out of the vegetable market.

"It's over! My head teacher, Teacher Lin, warned me yesterday that if I am late again this week, I will call my parents. But what happened today? I overslept again. No... no... It seems that Teacher Lin is still on duty at the school gate today. If she catches me late at the school gate, then..."

He has been late twice this week, and Su Lin actually didn't want to. Who makes the weather in May so suitable for dozing, especially when a heartless Su Lin sleeps like a pig.

"No matter, there are still ten minutes left. As long as you pass this vegetable market, turn a corner and go through a small alley, you will see the gate of Jian'an No. 1 Middle School. If you run faster, you should be able to catch the bell before the bell rings. As long as you enter the school after the bell rings, Teacher Lin will not be able to say anything to me..."

Looking at the cheap electronic watch that cost more than ten yuan in his hand, Su Lin quickly calculated in his mind.

Finally, after three long minutes, Su Lin finally fought his way through the aunt.

"There are still six or seven minutes, run faster, you will definitely make it in time!"

Looking at his watch again, Su Lin breathed a sigh of relief and was about to run all the way to school when he found a crowd of people gathered around the entrance of the vegetable market, chattering and watching something exciting.

"So many people around? What happened? Is it a car accident? That's not right... Motorized vehicles are not allowed in front of this market..."

Out of curiosity, which is also the common Chinese people's mentality of watching the excitement. Anyway, it won't take much time to take a look. Su Lin also squeezed into the crowd of spectators, stuck his head out, and looked inside.

Under the crowd, a white-haired old woman was lying on the ground, clutching her chest and humming in pain, as if she was ill.The onlookers were chattering about sending the old lady to the hospital, but there were many people talking, but no one really wanted to save the old lady.

"Oh... the old lady is sick. Send her to the hospital quickly... Why can't you young and strong guys move?"

"I think so too! But what if I get blackmailed when I get to the hospital?"

"Think of a solution quickly... The old man is in trouble..."

"Someone has been called, and the ambulance is on the way, but even if it comes, I'm afraid it won't be able to get in through the alleyway of the vegetable market..."

Hearing the words of these people, Su Lin understood in his heart that these people were afraid that they would be blackmailed after sending the old lady to the hospital. Such incidents were often reported on TV recently, so people nowadays do not dare to be good people easily.

Seeing the old woman struggling in pain on the ground, Su Lin's heart ached. He thought of his elderly grandmother. He immediately felt relieved and didn't think too much. He immediately broke away from the crowd, rushed forward, picked up the old woman, and ran towards the main road towards the exit of the vegetable market. Once you left the market, you could take a taxi to the municipal hospital.

"Isn't this young man afraid of being blackmailed?"

Su Lin no longer cares about the words of others. The only thought in his heart now is that he wants to save this old lady, no matter what the society is like, no matter whether she will be blackmailed afterwards.You cannot allow your conscience to be obscured because of this.

"Grandma, hold on, I'll take you to the hospital right away."

After having been delayed for such a long time, Su Lin knew that every minute and every second was crucial to the old woman. His legs were already running fast, and the only thought in his heart was to send the old woman to the hospital as soon as possible.

"Hurry up... hurry up... faster..."

Su Lin was over 1.7 meters tall and on the thin side. He was already out of breath after running so far with his grandmother in his arms, but he still persisted. Su Lin had already heard the sound of the ambulance coming, and he could see the road after passing this bend.

The old woman who was suffering from pain struggled to open her eyes, looked at the sweaty Su Lin, and expressed her gratitude with difficulty.

"Grandma, please stop talking and hold on. The ambulance is here. It's at the intersection ahead. You can go to the hospital soon."

After using his last strength, Su Lin finally ran out of the alley. The ambulance had stopped at the entrance of the alley, and the medical staff were setting up a stretcher to go in and save people.

"Quick...doctor...save...grandma..."

After carefully placing the old woman in the ambulance, Su Lin gasped and could no longer speak complete words.

"Young man, luckily you delivered it in time, don't worry! We'll leave the rest to us..."

The doctor who came with the ambulance briefly checked the old woman, and without telling Su Linduo, he immediately got into the ambulance and drove to the hospital while rescuing her on the road.

Seeing the ambulance speeding away, Su Lin breathed a sigh of relief.Looking at the watch on his hand, he immediately remembered that he had to rush to school. It was already 7:57, and the bell would ring in three minutes.

Su Lin shouted anxiously, but he didn't know that at this moment, in the void, a god who controlled time happened to see Su Lin rescuing people through infinite time and space.After hearing Su Lin's muttering, the God of Time waved his time scepter. Suddenly, a stream of cyan air flowed across countless time and space and penetrated into Su Lin's body.

"Since you have no time, I will give you time."

As the cyan air flow penetrated into Su Lin's body, Su Lin trembled all over and almost stumbled to the ground.

"What's going on? Why do you feel so cold suddenly..."

After a pause, the cold feeling disappeared again, and Su Lin ran towards the school again. Although it took a little time to save the old lady, fortunately, the directions were the same. From here, it was only more than a thousand meters to Jian'an No. 1 Middle School.

There is still one minute left, it should be in time if it goes faster.

Su Lin had already seen the homeroom teacher Lin Qingxue patrolling at the school gate from a distance. Lin Qingxue seemed to have seen Su Lin running wildly with his schoolbag on his back from a distance. But at this moment, the school bell rang.

The school bell rang suddenly, which seemed like a death knell to Su Lin.

"It's just a little bit close... It would be great if time could be paused at this time, so I could run into the campus..."

Although he was late because he was rescuing the old lady, Su Lin did not regret it at all. It was just that he now wished he could have a little more time, or pause a little longer, so that he could avoid being caught by Lin Qingxue being late.

Who knows, Su Lin just thought like this, and the whole world suddenly stopped.Unbelievable, Su Lin looked at everything in front of him. He originally saw Teacher Lin who he was about to come to talk to, and the willow trees on both sides of the school that were blown by the breeze.

No!Su Lin found that everything had stopped, but he was still able to move.Sulin was running fast just now, but now, it felt strange that everything around him was still, but Sulin was still running towards the campus.

When she ran to Teacher Lin, she looked at Teacher Lin's black suit, slightly transparent white shirt, black leather skirt and black stockings covering her thin legs. They were motionless. Su Lin was surprised. She had already run in front of the teacher, but she turned a blind eye. Even Lin Qingxue's long hair that was fluttering in the wind was frozen in the air.

"What's going on? Why...why doesn't everything move?"

Su Lin was horrified, but he still ran to the school in one breath, taking dozens of seconds.However, when Su Lin looked at the electronic watch on his hand, he found that the electronic watch on his hand was motionless, as if it was broken. The time was fixed at eight o'clock and one minute, and the hands did not move at all.

Looking around again, Su Lin was convinced that time had really paused, and everything around him, except himself, had stopped.

quiet!It was eerily quiet, not a single sound, dead quiet.

It's so terrible, this feeling, dead silence, without a trace of life.

Su Lin was really scared. It would be unimaginable for him to live in such a static space and time.

"Let's go! Move! You wretched watch, let's go..."

Surrounded by boundless fear, Su Lin roared at his watch. With this thought, everything around him suddenly recovered.

The wind continued to blow, the willow leaves were fluttering, and the sound of morning reading in the campus began again, and Su Lin heard a surprised voice from teacher Lin Qingxue at the school gate.

"Huh? It's weird. I just saw that brat Su Lin rushing over outside the school gate. I just told him yesterday that he was late again today. It's just weird, why is he missing again? Could it be that I'm hallucinating?"

Hearing Lin Qingxue's surprise, Su Lin, who was standing at the school gate behind Lin Qingxue, knew that time had returned and dared to stay inside the school gate. Without being discovered by Lin Qingxue, Su Lin hurriedly ran to the classroom of Class 2, Grade 3 (2).

However, Su Lin was about to run away, but Lin Qingxue turned around and found him, shouting at him: "Su Lin, stop!"
